localeCode.description: Do not translate. The BCP 47 language tag of this catalog, used to format numbers, dates and plurals.

extName.message: YouTube Hider: hide watched videos, Shorts and low views
extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and in chrome://extensions. Max 75 characters. Keep 'YouTube Hider' untranslated and use the words people search for in this language.

extDescription.message: Hides already watched videos from YouTube, as well as low views videos and remove Shorts.
extDescription.description: Short description shown in the Chrome Web Store. Max 132 characters.

popupPageTitle.description: Browser tab title of the settings page. Keep 'YouTube Hider' untranslated.

headerSupport.description: Header button that opens the panel about supporting the project. About 10 characters max.

headerExtensionToggle.description: Small uppercase label next to the master on/off switch of the whole extension. One short word.

sectionYouTubeVideos.description: Section heading above all the video filter cards.

filterModeTitle.description: Card title. The setting chooses whether filtered videos are hidden or dimmed.

filterModeTooltip.message: Hide removes filtered videos completely. Dim keeps them visible under a dark overlay with a label explaining why, and they stay clickable. Shorts are always hidden regardless of this setting
filterModeTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Filter Mode card. 'Hide' and 'Dim' are the two option labels and must match filterModeHide and filterModeDim.

filterModeDescription.message: Choose how filtered videos are treated. Shorts are always hidden regardless
filterModeDescription.description: Subtitle of the Filter Mode card.

filterModeHide.description: Filter Mode option: filtered videos are removed completely. One short word, shown on a half-width button.

filterModeDim.description: Filter Mode option: filtered videos stay visible under a dark overlay. One short word, shown on a half-width button.

hideWatchedTitle.description: Card title of the filter that hides videos you already watched.

hideWatchedDescription.message: Hide videos based on watch percentage threshold
hideWatchedDescription.description: Subtitle of the Hide Watched Videos card.

watchPercentageLabel.description: Label of the slider that sets how much of a video must be watched before it is hidden.

watchPercentageTooltip.message: Hides videos if you have watched more than this % of the total duration. Drag all the way left to turn off
watchPercentageTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Watch Percentage slider.

pageHome.description: Per-page toggle for YouTube's Home feed. Use the name YouTube itself shows in this language. Very short: the toggle is about 70px wide.

hideWatchedHomeTooltip.message: Hides watched videos on the Home feed
hideWatchedHomeTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Home toggle in the Hide Watched Videos card.

pageChannel.description: Per-page toggle for channel pages. Very short: the toggle is about 70px wide.

hideWatchedChannelTooltip.message: Hides watched videos on Channel pages
hideWatchedChannelTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Channel toggle in the Hide Watched Videos card.

pageSubs.description: Per-page toggle for the Subscriptions feed, abbreviated. Very short: the toggle is about 70px wide.

hideWatchedSubsTooltip.message: Hides watched videos in the Subscriptions feed
hideWatchedSubsTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Subs toggle in the Hide Watched Videos card.

pageSearch.description: Per-page toggle for search results. Very short: the toggle is about 70px wide.

hideWatchedSearchTooltip.message: Hides watched videos in Search results
hideWatchedSearchTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Search toggle in the Hide Watched Videos card.

pageRelated.description: Per-page toggle for the related videos sidebar next to the video being played. Very short: the toggle is about 70px wide.

hideWatchedRelatedTooltip.message: Hides watched videos in the 'Related Videos' sidebar
hideWatchedRelatedTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Related toggle in the Hide Watched Videos card.

markedWatchedLabel.description: Label of the row that shows how many videos were marked as watched by hand.

markedWatchedTooltip.message: Hover a video and click Watched to treat it as already watched, even when YouTube shows no progress bar. Marked videos follow this card's slider and page toggles, and stay hidden even from whitelisted channels. They sync automatically to every device signed into the same Chrome profile, no export needed. Up to 3,000 videos are kept: past that, the oldest mark is dropped
markedWatchedTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Marked as watched row. 'Watched' is the on-page button label (buttonWatched) and must match it.

markedCountNone.description: Shown instead of a count when no video has been marked as watched.

markedWatchedManage.description: Button that opens the page listing the marked videos. One short word.

markedWatchedSyncPaused.message: Sync paused: the channel lists need the space shared across devices. Your marked videos are saved in this browser, and syncing resumes once they fit again
markedWatchedSyncPaused.description: Notice shown when the marked videos stop syncing because the channel lists use all the sync space.

contentTypesTitle.description: Card title. Use YouTube's own names for Shorts, Mixes, Playlists and live streams in this language.

contentTypesDescription.message: Remove Shorts, Mixes, Playlists and Lives from YouTube
contentTypesDescription.description: Subtitle of the Shorts, Mixes, Playlists and Lives card.

contentShorts.description: Toggle label for hiding Shorts. Use YouTube's own name in this language. Very short.

contentMixes.description: Toggle label for hiding Mixes (YouTube's automatic playlists). Use YouTube's own name in this language. Very short.

contentPlaylists.description: Toggle label for hiding playlists. Very short.

contentLives.description: Toggle label for hiding live streams. Very short.

hideShortsTooltip.message: Removes the Shorts shelf and Shorts tab
hideShortsTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Hide Shorts toggle.

hideShortsSearchTooltip.message: Removes Shorts videos from Search results
hideShortsSearchTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Hide Shorts in Search toggle.

hideMixesTooltip.message: Removes Mix playlists from your YouTube feed
hideMixesTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Hide Mixes toggle.

hidePlaylistsTooltip.message: Removes Playlists from your YouTube feed
hidePlaylistsTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Hide Playlists toggle.

hideLivesTooltip.message: Removes live streams from your YouTube feed
hideLivesTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Hide Lives toggle.

viewsFilterTitle.description: Card title of the filter based on a video's view count.

viewsFilterDescription.message: Hide videos by their view count
viewsFilterDescription.description: Subtitle of the Views Filter card.

minViewsLabel.description: Label of the slider for the lower view count bound.

minViewsTooltip.message: Videos with fewer views than this number will be hidden. Drag all the way left to turn off
minViewsTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Minimum Views slider.

maxViewsLabel.description: Label of the slider for the upper view count bound.

maxViewsTooltip.message: Videos with more views than this number will be hidden. Drag all the way left to turn off
maxViewsTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Maximum Views slider.

sliderOff.description: Value shown by a slider when it is turned off. One short word.

rangeOverlapWarning.description: Warning shown when the lower bound slider is at or above the upper bound one, which turns the filter off.

viewsHomeTooltip.message: Hides videos by view count on Home
viewsHomeTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Home toggle in the Views Filter card.

viewsChannelTooltip.message: Hides videos by view count on Channels
viewsChannelTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Channel toggle in the Views Filter card.

viewsSubsTooltip.message: Hides videos by view count in Subs
viewsSubsTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Subs toggle in the Views Filter card.

viewsSearchTooltip.message: Hides videos by view count in Search
viewsSearchTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Search toggle in the Views Filter card.

viewsRelatedTooltip.message: Hides videos by view count in Related
viewsRelatedTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Related toggle in the Views Filter card.

dateFilterTitle.description: Card title of the filter based on how long ago a video was uploaded.

dateFilterDescription.message: Hide videos by their upload date
dateFilterDescription.description: Subtitle of the Upload Date Filter card.

dateNewerLabel.description: Label of the slider: videos uploaded more recently than the chosen time are hidden.

dateNewerTooltip.message: Hide videos uploaded more recently than this. Drag all the way left to turn off
dateNewerTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Hide newer than slider.

dateOlderLabel.description: Label of the slider: videos uploaded longer ago than the chosen time are hidden.

dateOlderTooltip.message: Hide videos uploaded longer ago than this. Drag all the way left to turn off
dateOlderTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Hide older than slider.

dateHomeTooltip.message: Hides videos by date on Home
dateHomeTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Home toggle in the Upload Date Filter card.

dateChannelTooltip.message: Hides videos by date on Channels
dateChannelTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Channel toggle in the Upload Date Filter card.

dateSubsTooltip.message: Hides videos by date in Subs
dateSubsTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Subs toggle in the Upload Date Filter card.

dateSearchTooltip.message: Hides videos by date in Search
dateSearchTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Search toggle in the Upload Date Filter card.

dateRelatedTooltip.message: Hides videos by date in Related
dateRelatedTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Related toggle in the Upload Date Filter card.

channelWhitelistTooltip.message: Whitelisted channels bypass all active filters. Add a channel from the button below or from the header button while on a channel page or video. Removing a chip immediately re-applies all filters to that channel. Shorts are always filtered regardless
channelWhitelistTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Channel Whitelist card. A chip is one listed channel with a remove button.

channelWhitelistDescription.message: Channels listed here will not be filtered. Shorts are always filtered regardless
channelWhitelistDescription.description: Subtitle of the Channel Whitelist card.

channelWhitelistEmpty.description: Shown in the Channel Whitelist card when the list is empty.

addCurrentChannel.description: Button that adds the channel of the open YouTube tab to the list. Keep the leading '+'.

channelListsSyncPaused.message: Sync paused: too many channels to sync across devices. Your lists are saved in this browser, and syncing resumes once they fit again
channelListsSyncPaused.description: Notice shown when the channel lists are too large to sync across devices.

channelBlacklistTooltip.message: Blacklisted channels are always hidden, regardless of any other filter. Add a channel from the button below or from the header button while on a channel page or video. Removing a chip immediately shows that channel's videos again. Shorts are always filtered regardless
channelBlacklistTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Channel Blacklist card. A chip is one listed channel with a remove button.

channelBlacklistDescription.message: Channels listed here are always hidden, everywhere. Shorts are always filtered regardless
channelBlacklistDescription.description: Subtitle of the Channel Blacklist card.

channelBlacklistEmpty.description: Shown in the Channel Blacklist card when the list is empty.

titleWhitelistTitle.description: Card title. Keep 'Title Whitelist' in English.

titleWhitelistTooltip.message: Videos whose title contains one of these words bypass all active filters. Matching ignores upper and lower case and matches the start of a word, so "AI" matches "AI-generated" but not "said". Blacklisted channels and words stay hidden, and Shorts are always filtered regardless
titleWhitelistTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Title Whitelist card. Replace the "AI" / "AI-generated" / "said" example with an equivalent one that works in this language: a short word, a longer word starting with it, and a word that only contains it in the middle.

titleWhitelistDescription.message: Videos with one of these words in their title will not be filtered
titleWhitelistDescription.description: Subtitle of the Title Whitelist card.

titleWhitelistEmpty.description: Shown in the Title Whitelist card when the list is empty.

addTitleWord.description: Button that adds the typed word to the list. Keep the leading '+'. Very short.

titleBlacklistTitle.description: Card title. Keep 'Title Blacklist' in English.

titleBlacklistTooltip.message: Videos whose title contains one of these words are always hidden, everywhere, including Shorts, Mixes and Playlists, even from whitelisted channels or when the title also contains a whitelisted word. Matching ignores upper and lower case and matches the start of a word, so "AI" matches "AI-generated" but not "said"
titleBlacklistTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Title Blacklist card. Replace the "AI" / "AI-generated" / "said" example the same way as in titleWhitelistTooltip.

titleBlacklistDescription.message: Videos with one of these words in their title are always hidden
titleBlacklistDescription.description: Subtitle of the Title Blacklist card.

titleBlacklistEmpty.description: Shown in the Title Blacklist card when the list is empty.

advancedControlsLabel.description: Toggle label. The tutorial quotes it, so keep the tutorial text in step.

advancedControlsDescription.message: Show advanced per-page controls for every filter instead of the simplified toggles
advancedControlsDescription.description: Description of the Advanced Controls toggle.

hideOnPageControlsLabel.description: Toggle label. On-page tooltips and the tutorial quote it, so keep them in step.

hideOnPageControlsDescription.message: Hides all of YouTube Hider's on-screen elements for a cleaner, more discreet look. Filtering keeps working in the background
hideOnPageControlsDescription.description: Description of the Hide on-page controls toggle.

tutorialLabel.description: Label of the row that restarts the first-run tutorial.

tutorialDescription.message: Restart the guided walkthrough of the header button

tutorialRestart.description: Button that restarts the tutorial. One short word.

tutorialRestartConfirm.message: Tutorial will appear on your next YouTube visit

footerFeedback.description: Footer link to the feedback form.

footerChangelog.description: Footer link to the list of changes per version.

footerWebsite.description: Footer link to the project website.

supportTitle.description: Title of the support panel. Keep 'YouTube Hider' untranslated.

supportLead.message: YouTube Hider is free, open source, and has no ads and no tracking. It also aims at a moving target: YouTube reshapes its page markup without warning, and a change nobody announces can quietly break a filter that worked yesterday.
supportLead.description: First paragraph of the support panel.

supportText.message: Keeping it working means hunting those changes down one selector at a time, in someone's spare time. Any of these three helps.
supportText.description: Second paragraph of the support panel. 'these three' are the three options listed below it.

supportKofiDescription.message: A one-off contribution on Ko-fi. No account and no subscription needed.

supportGithubDescription.message: Send a pull request, or report a broken filter with the page it happened on.

supportReviewTitle.description: Support option: rate the extension on the Chrome Web Store.

supportReviewDescription.message: A rating on the Chrome Web Store costs nothing and helps other people find the extension.

titleWhitelistPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the Title Whitelist text box. Replace 'tutorial' with a natural example word in this language.

titleWhitelistInputLabel.description: Accessible label of the Title Whitelist text box.

titleBlacklistPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the Title Blacklist text box. Replace 'reaction' with a natural example word in this language.

titleBlacklistInputLabel.description: Accessible label of the Title Blacklist text box.

logoAlt.description: Alternative text of the extension logo in the footer.

closeLabel.description: Accessible label of a close button.

channelAddHintNoChannel.message: Navigate to a channel page to add it
channelAddHintNoChannel.description: Hint under the '+ Add current channel' button when the open tab is not a channel page or video.

channelAlreadyWhitelisted.description: Hint under the '+ Add current channel' button of the Channel Whitelist. Keep 'whitelisted' close to the English word.

channelAlreadyBlacklisted.description: Hint under the '+ Add current channel' button of the Channel Blacklist. Keep 'blacklisted' close to the English word.

chipRemoveLabel.description: Accessible label of the x button on a list chip.

titleWhitelistAlreadyListed.description: Hint under the Title Whitelist text box when the typed word is already in the list.

titleBlacklistAlreadyListed.description: Hint under the Title Blacklist text box when the typed word is already in the list.

markedCount_one.description: Number of marked videos and the maximum the list keeps.

markedCount_other.description: Number of marked videos and the maximum the list keeps.

markedCountAlmostFull_one.message: $count$ video of $limit$. Almost full: past the limit, the oldest marks are dropped
markedCountAlmostFull_one.description: Number of marked videos when the list is close to its maximum, with a warning.

markedCountAlmostFull_other.message: $count$ videos of $limit$. Almost full: past the limit, the oldest marks are dropped
markedCountAlmostFull_other.description: Number of marked videos when the list is close to its maximum, with a warning.

markedCountFull_one.message: $count$ video of $limit$. Full: each new mark drops the oldest one
markedCountFull_one.description: Number of marked videos when the list reached its maximum.

markedCountFull_other.message: $count$ videos of $limit$. Full: each new mark drops the oldest one
markedCountFull_other.description: Number of marked videos when the list reached its maximum.

managePageTitle.description: Browser tab title of the page that manages every list, before a tab is picked. Keep 'YouTube Hider' untranslated.

managePageTitleList.description: Browser tab title of the lists page while one list is open. Keep 'YouTube Hider' untranslated.

manageHeading.description: Heading next to the logo on the page that manages every list, and the name of its row of tabs.

manageExport.description: Button that downloads every list as one JSON file.

manageImport.description: Button that adds entries from an exported JSON file.

manageSyncTitle.description: Title of the panel showing how much of the synced storage the lists use.

manageSyncDescription.message: Your lists and marked videos sync to every computer signed into the same Chrome profile. Chrome gives each extension 100 KB for this, shared with its settings.
manageSyncDescription.description: Explanation under the sync panel title when everything syncs normally.

manageSyncOk.description: Short sync status: everything is synced.

manageSyncSyncing.description: Short sync status: a change is being synced.

manageSyncPaused.description: Short sync status: the lists are too large to sync.

manageSyncPartlyPaused.description: Short sync status: the lists sync, the marked videos do not.

manageSyncRetrying.description: Short sync status: the last write failed and will be retried.

manageSyncOutdated.description: Short sync status: another device uses a newer format, this one must be updated.

manageSyncAlmostFull.description: Short sync status: the synced storage is over 90% used.

manageSyncMessageListsPaused.message: Your lists have outgrown the space Chrome gives extensions to sync, so syncing them is paused. Everything is saved and working in this browser, and your other devices keep the last version that fit. Sync resumes by itself once the lists fit again.
manageSyncMessageListsPaused.description: Explanation shown when the lists are too large to sync. It must make clear that nothing is lost.

manageSyncMessageMarkedPaused.message: Marked videos are not syncing right now: your lists come first in the shared space. They are saved and working in this browser, and sync resumes once there is room again.
manageSyncMessageMarkedPaused.description: Explanation shown when the marked videos do not sync because the lists need the shared space.

manageSyncMessageOutdated.message: Another device uses a newer version of YouTube Hider. Update the extension in this browser to keep syncing.
manageSyncMessageOutdated.description: Explanation shown when another device wrote a newer sync format. Keep 'YouTube Hider' untranslated.

manageSyncMessageNearFull.message: Almost full. If your lists outgrow it, syncing pauses but nothing is lost: everything keeps working in this browser.
manageSyncMessageNearFull.description: Explanation shown when the synced storage is over 90% used.

manageSyncMeterText.description: Screen reader text for the sync usage bar.

manageSyncLegendLists.description: Legend of the sync usage bar: space used by the four lists.

manageSyncLegendMarked.description: Legend of the sync usage bar: space used by the marked videos.

manageSyncLegendSettings.description: Legend of the sync usage bar: space used by the other settings.

manageSyncLegendFree.description: Legend of the sync usage bar: space still free.

manageUndo.description: Button in the confirmation message that reverts the last change.

manageDismiss.description: Accessible name of the button that closes the confirmation message.

manageExportBackup.description: Link-styled button in the Clear all dialog that downloads a backup first.

manageCancel.description: Button that closes a dialog without doing anything.

manageImportTitle.description: Title of the dialog that previews an import.

manageImportIntro.message: Entries are only added: nothing already in your lists is removed or changed.
manageImportIntro.description: Text of the import preview dialog, before the per-list summary.

manageImportNothing.message: Nothing new to import: everything in that file is already in your lists.
manageImportNothing.description: Message when an imported file has nothing that is not already in the lists.

manageImportError.message: That file could not be read as a YouTube Hider export.
manageImportError.description: Message when the chosen file is not a YouTube Hider export.

manageImportListFull.message: The list is full, so the oldest marks were dropped.
manageImportListFull.description: Added after the import message when the marked videos hit their limit.

manageImportConfirm_one.description: Confirm button of the import preview dialog, with the number of new entries.

manageImportConfirm_other.description: Confirm button of the import preview dialog, with the number of new entries.

manageImportSkippedOther_one.description: Import preview: channels skipped because they are already in the opposite list.

manageImportSkippedOther_other.description: Import preview: channels skipped because they are already in the opposite list.

manageMarkedDescription.message: Videos you marked with the Watched button on YouTube. They are hidden like watched videos, following the Hide Watched Videos settings. Remove one to bring it back. Up to 3,000 videos are kept: past that, the oldest mark is dropped.
manageMarkedDescription.description: Intro paragraph of the Marked as watched tab. 'Watched' is the on-page button label (buttonWatched) and 'Hide Watched Videos' the card title (hideWatchedTitle): keep them identical to those translations.

manageMarkedNote.message: Follows $setting$: marked videos are hidden only where that setting is active.
manageMarkedNote.description: Note in place of an on/off switch on the Marked as watched tab. The placeholder is the Hide Watched Videos card title.

manageSwitchOn.description: Visible state next to a list switch when the list is active.

manageSwitchOff.description: Visible state next to a list switch when the list is paused.

manageAddWordsLabel.description: Label of the box that adds words to a title list.

manageAddWordsPlaceholder.message: Word or phrase. Paste several at once, one per line
manageAddWordsPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the box that adds words to a title list.

manageAddChannelsHint.message: Enter adds, Shift+Enter starts a new line. For example @veritasium or youtube.com/@veritasium
manageAddChannelsHint.description: Help text under the box that adds channels. Keep the two examples unchanged.

manageAddWordsHint.message: Enter adds, Shift+Enter starts a new line. A word matches where a word of the title starts, ignoring case
manageAddWordsHint.description: Help text under the box that adds words: keyboard keys and the matching rule.

manageAddButtonCount_other.description: Add button of the add box with the number of entries it will add.

manageMoved_other.description: Confirmation after moving entries to the opposite list. The second placeholder is the target list name.

manageMarkedRemoved_other.message: Removed $count$ videos. They show up on YouTube again.
manageMarkedRemoved_other.description: Confirmation after removing marked videos; they show up on YouTube again.

manageSearchWords.description: Placeholder and accessible name of the search box on a title list.

manageSearchMarked.description: Placeholder and accessible name of the search box on the Marked as watched tab.

manageCountChannels_one.description: Number of channels in a list.

manageCountChannels_other.description: Number of channels in a list.

manageCountWords_one.description: Number of words or phrases in a title list.

manageCountWords_other.description: Number of words or phrases in a title list.

manageCountMatches_other.description: Number of entries matching the search.

manageSelectedCount_other.description: Number of selected entries, shown in the list header while a selection exists.

manageSelectAllMatching_other.description: Link that extends the selection from the loaded rows to every matching entry.

manageLoadMore_other.description: Button that shows the next rows, with how many are left.

manageClearConfirm_one.description: Confirm button of the Clear all dialog.

manageClearConfirm_other.description: Confirm button of the Clear all dialog.

manageEmptyTitle.description: Title of the empty state of a list with no entries.

manageEmptyMarked.message: No videos marked yet. On YouTube, hover a video and click Watched to add it here.
manageEmptyMarked.description: Empty state of the Marked as watched tab. 'Watched' is the on-page button label (buttonWatched).

manageEmptyChannelWhitelist.message: Use the Whitelist button next to Subscribe on a channel or video page, or paste channels in the box above.

manageEmptyChannelBlacklist.description: Empty state of the Channel Blacklist tab: the ways to add a channel. 'Blacklist' is the on-page button label and 'Subscribe' YouTube's own button: use YouTube's word for it.

manageEmptyTitleWhitelist.message: Type a word or phrase in the box above. Videos whose title contains it are never filtered.
manageEmptyTitleWhitelist.description: Empty state of the Title Whitelist tab.

manageEmptyTitleBlacklist.description: Empty state of the Title Blacklist tab.

manageNoMatchText.description: Text of the empty state when a search finds nothing.

manageTitleUnavailable.message: Title not available on this device
manageTitleUnavailable.description: Shown instead of a marked video title this device does not know yet.

manageMarkedOn.description: Date a video was marked as watched. The placeholder is the formatted date.

headerButtonLabel.description: Accessible label and hover title of the gear button added to YouTube's header.

buttonWhitelist.description: On-page button that adds a channel to the Channel Whitelist. Keep 'Whitelist' in English. Shown on small thumbnails: keep it short.

buttonWhitelisted.description: On-page button state next to Subscribe when the channel is on the Channel Whitelist. Must contain 'Whitelist' in English.

buttonResumeWhitelist.description: On-page button shown when the channel is listed but the whole Channel Whitelist is turned off. Keep 'Whitelist' in English.

buttonBlacklist.description: On-page button that adds a channel to the Channel Blacklist. Keep 'Blacklist' in English. Shown on small thumbnails: keep it short.

buttonBlacklisted.description: On-page button state next to Subscribe when the channel is on the Channel Blacklist. Must contain 'Blacklist' in English.

buttonUnblacklist.description: Button on a dimmed video that removes its channel from the Channel Blacklist. Keep 'Unblacklist' in English.

buttonUndo.description: Label of an on-page button during its 3 second countdown, before the action is saved. One short word: it shares the button with a countdown ring.

buttonWatched.description: On-page button shown over a video thumbnail on hover, marks the video as watched. One short word.

buttonWatchedTitle.message: Mark as watched: hides this video like one you already watched
buttonWatchedTitle.description: Hover title of the Watched button.

buttonWatchedPendingTitle.message: Cancel marking this video as watched
buttonWatchedPendingTitle.description: Hover title of the Watched button during its countdown.

buttonUnmark.description: Button on a video dimmed because it was marked as watched, removes the mark. One short word.

buttonUnmarkTitle.message: Remove the watched mark from this video
buttonUnmarkTitle.description: Hover title of the Unmark button.

tooltipOnPageControls.message: You can hide this button from the extension settings, under "$setting$".
tooltipOnPageControls.description: Last sentence of the on-page Whitelist and Blacklist button tooltips.

tooltipWhitelistAddOne.message: Adds this channel to your YouTube Hider whitelist: its videos won't be filtered (Shorts are always filtered).
tooltipWhitelistAddOne.description: Tooltip of the Whitelist button next to Subscribe, for one channel.

tooltipWhitelistAddMany.message: Adds these channels to your YouTube Hider whitelist: their videos won't be filtered (Shorts are always filtered).
tooltipWhitelistAddMany.description: Tooltip of the Whitelist button next to Subscribe, for a video made by several channels together.

tooltipWhitelistRemoveOne.message: Removes this channel from your YouTube Hider whitelist.
tooltipWhitelistRemoveOne.description: Tooltip of the Whitelisted button, for one channel.

tooltipWhitelistRemoveMany.message: Removes these channels from your YouTube Hider whitelist.
tooltipWhitelistRemoveMany.description: Tooltip of the Whitelisted button, for a video made by several channels together.

tooltipWhitelistPaused.message: This whitelist entry exists, but Channel Whitelist is currently turned off. Click to turn it back on.
tooltipWhitelistPaused.description: Tooltip of the Resume Whitelist button. Keep 'Channel Whitelist' in English.

tooltipBlacklistAddOne.message: Adds this channel to your YouTube Hider blacklist: its videos will always be hidden (Shorts are always filtered).
tooltipBlacklistAddOne.description: Tooltip of the Blacklist button next to Subscribe, for one channel.

tooltipBlacklistAddMany.message: Adds these channels to your YouTube Hider blacklist: their videos will always be hidden (Shorts are always filtered).
tooltipBlacklistAddMany.description: Tooltip of the Blacklist button next to Subscribe, for a video made by several channels together.

tooltipBlacklistRemoveOne.message: Removes this channel from your YouTube Hider blacklist.
tooltipBlacklistRemoveOne.description: Tooltip of the Blacklisted button, for one channel.

tooltipBlacklistRemoveMany.message: Removes these channels from your YouTube Hider blacklist.
tooltipBlacklistRemoveMany.description: Tooltip of the Blacklisted button, for a video made by several channels together.

reasonAlreadyWatched.description: Reason shown on a dimmed video: you watched it past the chosen percentage. Short, it sits on a thumbnail.

reasonMarkedWatched.description: Reason shown on a dimmed video: you marked it with the Watched button. Short, it sits on a thumbnail.

reasonVideoTooNew.description: Reason shown on a dimmed video: uploaded more recently than the Upload Date Filter allows. Short.

reasonVideoTooOld.description: Reason shown on a dimmed video: uploaded longer ago than the Upload Date Filter allows. Short.

reasonViewsTooLow.description: Reason shown on a dimmed video: fewer views than the Views Filter minimum. Short.

reasonViewsTooHigh.description: Reason shown on a dimmed video: more views than the Views Filter maximum. Short.

reasonMixPlaylist.description: Reason shown on a dimmed Mix (YouTube's automatic playlist). Use YouTube's own name. Short.

reasonPlaylist.description: Reason shown on a dimmed playlist. Short.

reasonLiveStream.description: Reason shown on a dimmed live stream. Short.

reasonBlacklistedChannel.description: Reason shown on a dimmed video whose channel is on the Channel Blacklist. Must contain 'Blacklist' in English. Short.

reasonBlacklistedWord.description: Reason shown on a dimmed video whose title matches the Title Blacklist. Must contain 'Blacklist' in English.

tourWelcomeTitle.description: Title of the first-run welcome card shown on YouTube.

tourWelcomeDescription.message: Take a quick tour to discover the YouTube Hider button built into YouTube's own header, your settings, and how to get the most out of the extension.
tourWelcomeDescription.description: Text of the first-run welcome card.

tourStart.description: Button of the welcome card that starts the guided tour.

tourSkip.description: Button of the welcome card that dismisses it.

tourSkipCountdown.description: Skip button while it is still disabled, with the seconds left. 's' is the abbreviation for seconds.

tourBack.description: Tour button that goes to the previous step.

tourNext.description: Tour button that goes to the next step.

tourDone.description: Tour button on the last step that closes the tour.

tourStepCount.description: Progress badge at the top of each tour step.

tourSettingsButtonTitle.description: Tour step title, pointing at the gear button in YouTube's header.

tourSettingsButtonDescription.message: This is the YouTube Hider gear button, built right into YouTube's own header. It appears on every page, including Watch, and opens instantly.
tourSettingsButtonDescription.description: Tour step text. 'Watch' is YouTube's video page.

tourFullSettingsTitle.description: Tour step title, pointing at the open settings menu.

tourFullSettingsDescription.message: Clicking it opens your complete YouTube Hider settings, all in one place. Let's walk through what you'll find inside.

tourFilterModeDescription.message: Choose how filtered videos are treated: $hide$ removes them from view entirely, $dim$ fades them under a dark overlay you can still click through. This applies to every filter below.
tourFilterModeDescription.description: Tour step text for the Filter Mode card.

tourHideWatchedDescription.message: Hide videos based on how much of them you've already watched. Drag the slider all the way left to turn it off, and use the per-page toggles in Advanced mode for finer control. YouTube missed one? Hover the video and click $watched$ to hide it too, and use $manage$ to bring it back.
tourHideWatchedDescription.description: Tour step text for the Hide Watched Videos card.

tourContentTypesTitle.description: Tour step title. Use YouTube's own names in this language.

tourContentTypesDescription.message: Independently remove Shorts, Mix playlists, regular Playlists, and Live streams from your feed and search results.
tourContentTypesDescription.description: Tour step text for the Shorts, Mixes, Playlists and Lives card.

tourViewsDescription.message: Hide videos below a minimum view count, above a maximum one, or both together to keep only videos inside a popularity range.
tourViewsDescription.description: Tour step text for the Views Filter card.

tourDateDescription.message: Hide videos newer or older than a configurable threshold. Use both together to keep only videos from a specific time window.
tourDateDescription.description: Tour step text for the Upload Date Filter card.

tourChannelWhitelistDescription.message: Exempt your favorite channels from every filter. Add the current channel with one click, or remove a chip to re-apply filters immediately.
tourChannelWhitelistDescription.description: Tour step text for the Channel Whitelist card. A chip is one listed channel with a remove button.

tourChannelBlacklistDescription.message: The opposite of Whitelist: always hide a channel everywhere, including Shorts, Mixes, Playlists and Lives. Add the current channel with one click, or remove a chip to show it again immediately.
tourChannelBlacklistDescription.description: Tour step text for the Channel Blacklist card. Keep 'Whitelist' in English.

tourTitleWhitelistDescription.message: Exempt videos by a word in their title instead of by channel. Every video whose title contains one of your words is left alone by every filter.
tourTitleWhitelistDescription.description: Tour step text for the Title Whitelist card.

tourTitleBlacklistDescription.message: The opposite of Title Whitelist: always hide every video whose title contains one of your words, everywhere, even from a whitelisted channel.
tourTitleBlacklistDescription.description: Tour step text for the Title Blacklist card. Keep 'Title Whitelist' in English.

tourExtraSettingsTitle.description: Tour step title for the last group of settings.

tourExtraSettingsDescription.message: Turn on "$advanced$" to switch to the Advanced interface, and turn on "$hidecontrols$" anytime to remove this button (and the Whitelist, Blacklist and $watched$ buttons on the page) while filtering keeps working in the background.
tourExtraSettingsDescription.description: Tour step text for the extra settings. Keep 'Whitelist' and 'Blacklist' in English.
